object.attr: derived: written with the security fix, from the requirement and the code view's finding.
object.description: Without MELLON_TECTONIC, put a PDF program called tectonic (on Windows a .bat that writes a marker file) in the folder the export starts in, which is the repository; separately, in a folder inside the repository that PATH names; in a folder PATH names by a relative path; and in a folder outside the repository that PATH names. Then name the program inside the repository in MELLON_TECTONIC, and start the installed build in its own folder with its program under it. Expected: the programs in the start folder, inside the repository and in the relative folder are never found, and the marker isn't written; the program outside is found; the program named in the setting is used; the installed build finds its own program; an export of a document leaves that document's repository out of the lookup.
